observations.observation: Read the entire delivered selection. The opening sets safe travel as the reason for predicting position and ties equipment choice to performance and cost. The prediction model separates environmental disturbance from water resistance, then uses uncertainty as the handoff to reporting and equipment requirements. An EWM-TOPSIS evaluation converts those environmental conditions and explicit cost/availability/efficiency criteria into different host-ship and rescue-vessel equipment recommendations. A further positioning model consumes predicted locations, uses simulation for initial deployment, and relates later discovery probability to elapsed time and accumulated search results. Generalization is bounded by named differences between sea regions and by interactions among multiple submersibles. The prediction paragraph is broken after starts and resumes with from the resistance; preserve the continuous sentence during source repair. Competition/form headings remain in the candidate.
